uncertain: 10K: one JFET source resistor in stage B is drawn '.10K', read as 10K like the other three

4 JFET source loads (one drawn '.10K', read as 10K), 1458 A input and feedback, H.F. comp, 3080 E feedback
1458 A + input to ground and 2N3906 pair base feed
Freq CV scale string and 741 C + input
3 around 741 A input, 1 in the Range string
Freq and Reson pot wiper resistors
